name: org.machanism.machai:project-layout
description: Project Layout is a Java utility library for detecting and describing conventional repository directory structures. It gives build tools, scanners, code generators, documentation tools, validation utilities, and project indexers a common API for finding production sources, tests, resources, documentation, and modules. The library detects Maven projects from pom.xml, Gradle projects from build.gradle, JavaScript or TypeScript projects from package.json, and Python projects from pyproject.toml and related files; unrecognized directories use a filesystem-based fallback. MavenProjectLayout reads Maven model metadata, including module declarations and configured source, resource, test, and test-resource roots. GradleProjectLayout supplies conventional Gradle roots and can query child projects through the Gradle Tooling API. JScriptProjectLayout expands package.json workspace globs. ProjectLayoutManager selects the appropriate implementation, while ProjectProcessor provides a reusable recursive module-processing base class.

constructors.description: Creates a Maven-aware layout. Configure the project root before querying modules or directory roots.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.project.layout.MavenProjectLayout layout = new org.machanism.machai.project.layout.MavenProjectLayout().projectDir(new java.io.File("./service"));
java.util.Collection<java.lang.String> sources = layout.getSources();
examples.description: Creates and configures a layout for a Maven project, then obtains its production source and resource roots.

constructors.description: Creates a Gradle-aware layout that supplies conventional Gradle roots and can inspect the Gradle project model.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.project.layout.GradleProjectLayout layout = new org.machanism.machai.project.layout.GradleProjectLayout().projectDir(new java.io.File("./gradle-service"));
java.util.List<java.lang.String> tests = layout.getTests();
examples.description: Configures a Gradle layout and retrieves its conventional test root.

constructors.description: Creates a JavaScript and TypeScript project layout that reads package.json workspace metadata.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.project.layout.JScriptProjectLayout layout = new org.machanism.machai.project.layout.JScriptProjectLayout().projectDir(new java.io.File("./web-workspace"));
java.util.List<java.lang.String> modules = layout.getModules();
examples.description: Configures a JavaScript workspace layout and discovers workspace module paths.

constructors.description: Creates a Python project layout used to identify Python project descriptors and provide safe empty root collections where discovery is not implemented.

examples.description: Tests a directory for Python project indicators before selecting project-specific processing.

constructors.description: Creates the fallback layout for directories that have no recognized Maven, Gradle, JavaScript, or Python descriptor.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.project.layout.DefaultProjectLayout layout = new org.machanism.machai.project.layout.DefaultProjectLayout().projectDir(new java.io.File("./unknown-repository"));
java.util.List<java.lang.String> modules = layout.getModules();
examples.description: Uses filesystem-based immediate-subdirectory discovery for an otherwise unknown repository.

constructors.description: Creates a utility for parsing Maven POM files into Maven Model instances and accessing collected POM properties.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.project.layout.PomReader reader = new org.machanism.machai.project.layout.PomReader();
org.apache.maven.model.Model model = reader.getProjectModel(new java.io.File("./pom.xml"));
examples.description: Reads Maven metadata directly when a tool needs the parsed Maven model.

features.name: detectProjectLayout
features.signature: public static org.machanism.machai.project.layout.ProjectLayout detectProjectLayout(java.io.File projectDir) throws java.io.FileNotFoundException
features.description: Detects Maven, Gradle, JavaScript or TypeScript, and Python projects in that order, configures the selected layout with the supplied directory, and falls back to DefaultProjectLayout when no supported descriptor exists.

examples.description: Use automatic detection when a scanner must analyze repositories created with different build systems.

features.name: getSources
features.description: Returns production source roots relative to the configured project directory. Maven layouts include configured or default source and resource directories; Gradle layouts return the conventional src/main root.

examples.description: Resolve each returned root against the configured project directory before scanning its files.

features.name: getTests
features.description: Returns test roots relative to the configured project directory, including Maven test source and resource roots or the conventional Gradle src/test root.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.project.layout.MavenProjectLayout layout = new org.machanism.machai.project.layout.MavenProjectLayout().projectDir(new java.io.File("./application"));
java.util.List<java.lang.String> testRoots = layout.getTests();
examples.description: Collect test roots for test analysis or test-resource processing.

features.name: getModules
features.description: Returns child module paths when the configured project is a supported multi-module repository. Maven reads pom.xml modules for pom-packaging projects; Gradle reads child projects; JavaScript expands workspace globs.

examples.description: Handle null because a flat project may not declare modules.

features.name: getRelativePath
features.signature: public static java.lang.String getRelativePath(java.io.File dir, java.io.File file, boolean addSingleDot)
features.description: Computes a project-relative path for a file within a base directory, optionally adding a leading ./ prefix. It returns null when an absolute target lies outside the base directory.

examples.description: Convert a scanned file path to a stable root-relative value for reporting or indexing.

features.name: getProjectModel
features.description: Reads a pom.xml file into an Apache Maven Model after lightweight property substitution and makes parsed properties available through PomReader.

examples.snippet:
org.apache.maven.model.Model model = new org.machanism.machai.project.layout.PomReader().getProjectModel(new java.io.File("./pom.xml"));
java.lang.String artifactId = model.getArtifactId();
examples.description: Read Maven coordinates for a custom build report or repository index.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.project.layout.ProjectLayout
studs.description: Base contract for configured project layouts. It defines root-relative source, document, and test discovery plus shared path and filesystem utilities.

examples.description: Program against the common abstraction so tooling works across supported project ecosystems.

examples.name: Install, configure, and use Project Layout in a Maven tool
steps: Add the dependency org.machanism.machai:project-layout:1.4.0 to the consuming Maven project's dependencies.
Build the consumer with mvn clean verify so Maven resolves the library from Maven Central or the configured artifact repository.
Configure the target repository by passing its root directory as java.io.File to ProjectLayoutManager.detectProjectLayout.
Run the consumer's normal Maven goal or Java application; the consumer uses getSources, getTests, getDocuments, and getModules to drive its processing.

examples.name: Process a Maven multi-module repository
steps: Point the layout manager at the parent directory containing pom.xml.
Obtain modules from the detected Maven layout.
Resolve each module path against the parent project directory and analyze its own layout.
examples.description: This scenario lets an indexer or generator traverse Maven modules without hard-coding source-folder conventions.
